source_claim: The official Gridman Universe movie site publishes a consolidated cast including Gridman and Dynazenon series characters and explicitly names Namiko and Hassu. This establishes the two exact current residual members as movie-cast characters but does not identify the campaign's remaining unresolved tag identities.
notes: The official Gridman Universe movie site names Namiko and Hassu in its consolidated cast. These are exact current campaign character keys; the site also lists the broader GRIDMAN and DYNAZENON cast. The cast page uses the display name 六花ママ and 二代目 without connecting them to the specific residual tags takarada_orie and anosillus_ii, so those are not inferred here.
